science.schedule: Full-D10 followed by two Fast-D2 requests
science.interpretation: Periodic Full/fast system; does not establish standalone fast-path or adaptive-selector benefit

requirements: native Full and uncompensated fixed-mask parity
exact residual layer identities and hidden-update execution
policy Full/Fast/Fast schedule and paired noise
paired initial observation before any action

fixed_input_cost.conditions: Full and all three fixed masks
fixed_input_cost.primary: Completed policy_wall_ms; Full/Fast stages and three-request cycles reported separately
fixed_input_cost.excluded: Service loading, numerical gate, and six probe warmup rounds are separate preparation costs
fixed_input_cost.scope: Cost only; fixed observations do not establish quality, acceptance, or closed-loop speed

frozen_selection.rule: Both success rates >=0.60 and both measured mean three-request costs < Full; maximize min(two opposite suite differences), then fixed condition/suite order
frozen_selection.limitation: Discovery selects the pair and category labels; it is not independent evidence of reproducibility

analysis.primary: Paired success differences in the two frozen suite directions; report discordant counts and exact paired tests
analysis.selection: Pair and directions copied from discovery selection; never reselect or relabel from validation
analysis.interpretation: Separate direction reproduction from statistical resolution; other suite/task comparisons descriptive
analysis.multiplicity: Holm adjustment for the two preregistered one-sided exact paired tests if significance claims are made
analysis.size: 200 episodes per planned condition; exploratory independent confirmation, not official 50-init benchmark

gate_condition_scope: All four defined conditions remain available to unchanged numerical gate/cost probe; only planned_conditions launch rollouts
